Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4171, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney / .claude-team2; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Needs changes before merge.** One blocker: the post writes a wrong `TP` / `TN` with no refusal when two tapered cuts have different bottoms. All tests are green.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code. It is the first review of this PR. The PR is stacked on #4139. I reviewed the diff of this PR over the head of #4139 (`430c41c52`). The review of #4139 covers the wire offset part.

## What looks good

- The conversion in `onPart` is correct. The wire is one straight line, and the post moves X Y and U V along it from the guide planes to the part's planes.
- The start order of #4065 does not change. `TP`, `TN` and `G74` follow the `C` word. `G75` comes before `T90`.
- Each case that the post cannot write is a refusal by name: no table height, missing planes, the angle form, an arc, the wire offset, a second setup, a cut that ends with the wire leaning.
- No new command is necessary: the option uses `SetPostScriptOptions` and its MCP tool.
- The decision file, the `Changelog:` line, "Goldens moved", `Fixes #4075` and the provenance and Gate map lines are present. The new tests join the existing suite `script_sodick_ln2w`.
- The PR changes no `crates/ui` code, so screenshots are not necessary.

## Results, merged with main

Built and tested locally on m3. The trial merge of head `23d2e28d3` with `upstream/main` `12ea01a45` is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 854 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (51.8 min) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| Heavy lanes | not run (not a merge condition; no heavy record names this head) |

The quick gate includes these steps, all green:

- `post suites: script_sodick_ln2w` (the 7 new pins)
- `app suites: wire_post` (the 2 app pins and the new golden)
- `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`
- `app suites: conformance`

Extra suites run (TEST DATA rule; the diff adds `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-ln2w/edm_test_taper.nc`): the two test sources that read this directory are `crates/app/tests/wire_post/sodick_aq600l.rs` (`wire_post`) and `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` (`conformance`). The two are green. The diff does not touch importer code.

Mutations that I ran again (each one restored after the run):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `onPart`: no move from the lower guide to the part's bottom (`d = 0`) | red: 2 pins fail |
| `onSectionEnd`: no refusal of a cut that ends with the wire leaning | red: `a_taper_that_ends_leaning_is_refused_by_name` |
| `taperWhy`: no refusal of a second setup | red: `tapers_from_two_setups_are_refused_by_name` |
| `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs` from #4139 with the new post | red: the 2 app pins fail ("the stream states no PARAM WireGuideLower") |

Golden `edm_test_taper.nc`, read line by line:

- The fixture is 50 x 30 mm at the bottom and 44 x 24 mm at the top, over 20 mm. atan(3 / 20) = 8.531 deg, as the note says.
- The kerf on the bottom plane is 0.165 / cos(8.531 deg) = 0.167 mm. The bottom wire is at X +-25.167 and Y +-15.167. Correct.
- `U3.` on the -X wall, `U-3.` on the +X wall, `V3.` on the -Y wall, `V-3.` on the +Y wall. The top is 3 mm inward on each wall. Correct.
- Each corner is one block with the U V of the two walls (a mitre).
- The lead-in starts with `U0. V0.` on the `G00`. The lead-out ends with `U0. V0.` before `G75`.
- `TP5.` and `TN25.`: the option is 5 mm and the part is 20 mm high. Correct.
- No other recorded program changed. This agrees with "Goldens moved".

## Requested before merge

1. **Blocker (wrong G-code, no refusal): `TP` does not follow the section's `WireBottom`.** `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:518-519` (`startCut`), with `taperWhy` at lines 453-463.
   - The post writes `TP` = the option for each tapered section. But X Y are on the plane of that section's `WireBottom`.
   - `WireBottom` is the bottom height of the operation (`hs.bottom`, `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs:165`). Two Wire Contour operations in one setup can have different bottom heights.
   - I ran a probe with the option at 5 mm: two sections in `Setup1`, the first with `WireBottom` 0 and `WireTop` 20, the second with `WireBottom` 8 and `WireTop` 20. The post gave no warning. The second section got:
     ```
     TP5.
     TN17.
     G74
     G01 X-24.1 Y10. U0.6 V0.
     ```
     The second cut starts 8 mm higher, so the correct words are `TP13.` and `TN25.`. With `TP5.` the control puts the X Y plane 8 mm too low. On a 3 deg taper the wall is 0.4 mm out of position.
   - Class: the post holds one table height for the program, but each section has its own programmed plane. The same error occurs with one operation whose bottom height is not the bottom of the part.
   - Please use one rule that closes the class. Two rules are possible:
     - Tie the option to a fixed work Z. For example, the option is the height of the first taper's `WireBottom`, and a later section gets `TP` = option + (its `WireBottom` - the first `WireBottom`), `TN` = `TP` + its height.
     - Or refuse by name each later taper whose `WireBottom` is not the first one (the same form as the refusal of a second setup).
   - In the two cases, name the work Z in the section note (for example "TP 5. IS WORK Z0. ABOVE THE WORKTABLE"), so that the operator can check the plane and not only the number.
   - Add a pin for two tapered sections in one setup with different `WireBottom` values.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:411` and `:605`: the refusals of a two-profile 4-axis cut and of a leaning positioning move say "writes vertical 2-axis cuts only" and "writes no U V lean". This is no longer accurate.
- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:691`: by reading (not run), a tapered cut with tabs ends its main section with the wire leaning. It gets the refusal "give it an upright lead-out", which does not name the tabs. The refusal is safe. The message can name the cause.
- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:456`: when `WireBottom` or `WireTop` is absent because the height does not resolve, "generate and post it again" does not help. The message can say that the bottom or top height of the cut does not resolve.
- `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs` grows from 417 to 425 lines. It was over 400 lines before this PR. The body names this. A split can be a `P7` follow-up.
- The output was not run on a control. The body says so, and the program header says so.

## Labels

- `needs-rework` is set. The PR stays a draft.
- #4139 must merge first (the body says so).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the one blocker of the review on head `23d2e28d3`. The new head is `768fb3231`.

## Finding 1: `TP` did not follow the section's `WireBottom`

I used the first rule of the review: the option is tied to a fixed work Z.

- The option `partBottomAboveTable` is the `TP` of the first tapered cut of the program. The post keeps the `WireBottom` of that cut.
- A later tapered cut gets `TP` = the option + (its `WireBottom` - the first `WireBottom`). `TN` = `TP` + its height.
- This closes the class: `TP` always names the plane that X Y are on.
- The post refuses by name a tapered cut whose `TP` is below the worktable.
- Each section note names the work Z. Example: `TP 13. IS WORK Z8. ABOVE THE WORKTABLE - THE POST OPTION STATES WORK Z0. AT 5. - CHECK IT ON THE MACHINE`.
- The probe of the review (option 5, `WireBottom` 0 then 8, `WireTop` 20) now gives `TP13.` and `TN25.` for the second section.
- The option description, `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, the user guide and the decision file say the new rule.

Pins (`crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w/taper.rs`, binary `script_sodick_ln2w`):

- `tp_follows_each_tapered_sections_own_bottom`: two tapered sections in one setup with `WireBottom` 0 and 8. It asserts `TP` / `TN`, the X Y U V words and the two notes. It also asserts the reverse order.
- `a_tapered_section_below_the_worktable_is_refused_by_name`.

Mutation checks:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `tpOf()` returns only the option (the old `TP`) | red: the two new pins fail |
| no refusal of a `TP` below the worktable | red: `a_tapered_section_below_the_worktable_is_refused_by_name` fails |
| restored | green |

Golden: `edm_test_taper.nc` changed in its taper note line only. I made it again with `WRITE_GOLDEN`. No other recorded program changed.

## Results on head `768fb3231`, against `upstream/main` `e6849c5ae`

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 853 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (51.3 min) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --only "app heavy: wire_post"` | 1 step, 0 failed |

The quick gate includes `script_sodick_ln2w`, `wire_post`, `conformance` and the three `example_catalog*` suites. All are green.

## Not changed

- I did not change the four notes that do not block. They can be a `P7` follow-up.
- The PR is still a draft. It is still stacked on #4139.

Please review the new head again.

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4171, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney / .claude-team2; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The fix commit closes the one blocker of the earlier review. All tests are green.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review, because the PR changes posted G-code. The earlier review was on head `23d2e28d3`. The new head is `768fb3231`. It has one new commit: `fix(post): Sodick LN2W TP follows each tapered section's own bottom`. #4139 is now merged, so the PR diff over `upstream/main` is only the taper work.

## Earlier findings

1. **Blocker: `TP` did not follow the section's `WireBottom`.** Fixed in `768fb3231`.
   - `tpOf()` (`assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:461`) returns the option + (this section's `WireBottom` - the `WireBottom` of the first tapered cut). `startCut` writes `TP` and `TN` from `tpOf()` (lines 528-529).
   - The post keeps the first base in `taperBase` (line 440). It sets the base only on a section that passes all of its section checks.
   - A `TP` below the worktable is refused by name (line 471). No word of that section is written.
   - The section note names the work Z of `TP` and the work Z that the option states (line 451).
   - The rule closes the class: `TP` always names the plane that X Y are on. I read the probe case of the earlier review in the new pin. With `WireBottom` 0 then 8 and the option at 5, the second section gets `TP13.` and `TN25.`, with `G01 X-24.1 Y10. U0.6 V0.`. This agrees with my calculation: the wire moves 0.05 x 18 = 0.9 mm, and the lean over 12 mm is 0.6 mm.
   - Pins: `tp_follows_each_tapered_sections_own_bottom` (the two orders) and `a_tapered_section_below_the_worktable_is_refused_by_name`.

The four non-blocking notes of the earlier review are not changed. The author says that they can be a `P7` follow-up. They do not block.

## Results, merged with main

Built and tested locally on m3. The trial merge of head `768fb3231` with `upstream/main` `e6849c5ae` is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 854 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (51.7 min) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed (3.5 min) |
| Heavy lanes | not run (not a merge condition, `P6`) |

The quick gate includes these steps, all green:

- `post suites: script_sodick_ln2w` (34 passed, with the 2 new pins)
- `app suites: wire_post` (29 passed, with the golden `edm_test_taper.nc`)
- `app suites: conformance`
- `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`

Extra suites run (TEST DATA rule): the diff adds `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-ln2w/edm_test_taper.nc`. The test sources that read this directory are `wire_post` and `conformance`. The two are green. The diff does not touch importer code.

Mutations that I ran again on the new head (each one restored after the run):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `tpOf()` returns only the option (the old `TP`) | red: `tp_follows_each_tapered_sections_own_bottom` and `a_tapered_section_below_the_worktable_is_refused_by_name` fail |
| no refusal of a `TP` below the worktable (line 471 off) | red: `a_tapered_section_below_the_worktable_is_refused_by_name` fails |
| restored | green: 34 passed |

Goldens: the fix commit changes one line of `edm_test_taper.nc`, the taper note. The new note is `(TAPER 8.531 DEG - 4-AXIS G74 - TP 5. IS WORK Z0. ABOVE THE WORKTABLE - THE POST OPTION STATES WORK Z0. AT 5. - CHECK IT ON THE MACHINE)`. No executable word changed. No other recorded program changed. This agrees with "Goldens moved" in the body.

## Labels

- `needs-rework` is removed. `merge-ready` is set. The PR merges cleanly with `main`.
- This is a `feat` PR. By AGENTS.md it merges at the next minor cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
